description: This file contains utility functions and constants for managing curriculum content, structure, and localization in the FreeCodeCamp project. It includes functions for retrieving directory paths, reading and writing curriculum and block structures, and handling internationalization directories.

methods.name: getContentConfig
methods.description: Returns directory paths for curriculum content based on language and optional overrides, asserting existence of i18n directories for non-English languages.

methods.name: getContentDir
methods.description: Returns the appropriate content directory path for a specified language.

methods.name: getCurriculumStructure
methods.description: Reads and parses the curriculum JSON structure from the filesystem.

methods.name: getBlockStructurePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for a block's structure JSON file.

methods.name: getBlockStructureDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where block structures are stored.

methods.name: createBlockFolder
methods.description: Creates a new directory for a block within the content structure.

methods.name: getBlockStructure
methods.description: Reads and parses a block's structure JSON file.

methods.name: writeBlockStructure
methods.description: Formats and writes a block's structure JSON to disk.

methods.name: writeSuperblockStructure
methods.description: Formats and writes a superblock's structure JSON to disk.

methods.name: getSuperblockStructure
methods.description: Reads and parses a superblock's structure JSON file.

methods.name: getSuperblockStructurePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for a superblock's structure JSON file.

methods.name: getLanguageConfig
methods.description: Returns directory paths for curriculum content and i18n based on language, asserting existence of i18n directories for non-English languages.
